TileStructure.Forest.first_tree_pointwis.statement: Let $X$ be a metric space, let $a\in\mathbb N$, $q\in\mathbb R$, $K:X\to X\to\mathbb C$, $\sigma_1,\sigma_2:X\to\mathbb Z$ and $F,G\subseteq X$, and assume the standing hypotheses `ProofData a q K σ₁ σ₂ F G` (which equip $X$ with the volume measure $\mu$ and the function $Q$ used below). Assume moreover a tile structure `TileStructure Q (defaultD a) (defaultκ a) (defaultS X) (cancelPt X)` on $X$, with tiles $\mathfrak P(X)$ and grid cubes $\mathrm{Grid}(X)$; write $D=\mathrm{defaultD}(a)$ and $S=\mathrm{defaultS}(X)$. (Lemma 7.1.4.) Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $t$ be a forest of level $n$ (`Forest X n`), let $u\in\mathfrak P(X)$ with $u\in t$, let $L\in\mathrm{Grid}(X)$ with $L\in\mathcal L(\mathfrak T_t(u))$ (where $\mathfrak T_t(u)$ is `t.𝔗 u` and $\mathcal L$ is `Forest.𝓛`), let $x,x'\in X$ with $x\in L$ and $x'\in L$, and let $f:X\to\mathbb C$ be bounded with compact support (with respect to $\mu$). Then, writing $\mathrm i$ for the imaginary unit, $$\Big\|\sum_{s\in\sigma_t(u,x)}\int_X\Big(\exp\big(\mathrm i\,(-\mathcal Q(u)(y)+Q(x)(y)+\mathcal Q(u)(x)-Q(x)(x))\big)-1\Big)K_s(x,y)\,f(y)\,d\mu(y)\Big\|_e\le C_{7.1.4}(a)\cdot M\big(P(|f|)\big)(x'),$$ where $\|\cdot\|_e$ is the extended (ENNReal-valued) norm, $\sigma_t(u,x)$ is the finite set of integers `t.σ u x`, $\mathcal Q(u)$ is `𝒬 u`, $K_s$ is `Ks s`, $C_{7.1.4}(a)$ is `Forest.C7_1_4 a`, $P(|f|)$ is `Forest.approxOnCube (Forest.𝓙 (t.𝔗 u)) (fun x => ‖f x‖)`, and $M$ is `maximalFunction volume Forest.𝓑 Forest.c𝓑 Forest.r𝓑 1` (the maximal function with respect to $\mu$ with exponent $1$ over the family `Forest.𝓑` with centers `Forest.c𝓑` and radii `Forest.r𝓑`).
